proposedOverrides.name: Dutch Brazil
proposedOverrides.summary: Dutch Brazil was a West India Company colony in northeastern Brazil, established by conquest in 1630 and lost in 1654. Sugar production, slavery, religious communities and ambitious scientific collecting shaped its short history. The imported map’s 1650 to 1715 range must not be mistaken for the colony’s actual lifespan.
